name: iter_freeze_normal
description: LAYER-FREEZING PERSPECTIVE, standard setting: retraining with the initial model's first hidden layer frozen (exactly, via the fixed feature map models.FrozenFirstLayer) against the unfrozen protocol, for the three mix policies. Freezing halves what a round of concentrated training can overwrite, so it is a structural counter to forgetting - the question is whether it protects the static mix without blunting the repair. K=8, 15 seeds.
